=== cgroup.controllers ===
cpu io memory pids
=== cgroup.subtree_control ===
cpu pids
=== cpuset.cpus (root) ===
cat: /sys/fs/cgroup/cpuset.cpus: No such file or directory
=== try create child + cpuset ===
mkdir ok

observation.command: echo "=== cgroup.controllers ==="; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cgroup.controllers; echo "=== cgroup.subtree_control ==="; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cgroup.subtree_control; echo "=== cpuset.cpus (root) ==="; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpuset.cpus 2>&1; echo "=== try create child + cpuset ==="; mkdir /sys/fs/cgroup/probe 2>&1 && echo "mkdir ok"; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/probe/cgroup.controllers 2>&1; ls /sys/fs/cgroup/probe/ 2>&1 | grep -i cpuset; rmdir /sys/fs/cgroup/probe 2>/dev/null
